input.question: At what model scale does chain-of-thought prompting start to help, and why is this described as an emergent ability?

supporting.quote: chain-of-thought prompting does not positively impact performance for small models, and only yields performance gains when used with models of ∼100B parameters
supporting.why: Chain-of-thought gains appear only around 100B parameters.

supporting.quote: we also consider the technique an emergent ability
supporting.why: A technique that only helps above a scale threshold is called emergent.

draft_answer: Chain-of-thought prompting helps only for models of roughly 100B parameters; below that it does not improve performance, which is why it is described as emergent.
